mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_model_health_snapshot ( model_config_id, tenant_id, health_status, auth_status, capability_status, consecutive_failures, consecutive_successes, last_latency_ms, last_error_category, last_message, last_probe_at, last_success_at, last_failure_at, next_probe_at, cooldown_until, override_mode, override_reason, override_operator_id, override_operator_name, override_until, revision ) VALUES ( #{modelConfigId}, #{tenantId}, #{healthStatus}, #{authStatus}, #{capabilityStatus}, #{consecutiveFailures}, #{consecutiveSuccesses}, #{lastLatencyMs}, #{lastErrorCategory}, #{lastMessage}, #{lastProbeAt}, #{lastSuccessAt}, #{lastFailureAt}, #{nextProbeAt}, #{cooldownUntil}, #{overrideMode}, #{overrideReason}, #{overrideOperatorId}, #{overrideOperatorName}, #{overrideUntil}, #{revision} )
mapper.select: SELECT model.* FROM ai_model_config model LEFT JOIN ai_model_health_snapshot health ON health.model_config_id = model.id AND health.tenant_id = model.tenant_id WHERE model.deleted = 0 AND model.status = 1 AND model.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' AND (health.next_probe_at IS NULL OR health.next_probe_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY COALESCE(health.next_probe_at, model.create_time), model.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT model.* FROM ai_model_health_snapshot health INNER JOIN ai_model_config model ON model.id = health.model_config_id AND model.tenant_id = health.tenant_id WHERE model.deleted = 0 AND health.override_mode IN ('FORCE_HEALTHY', 'FORCE_UNHEALTHY') AND health.override_until IS NOT NULL AND health.override_until <= #{now} ORDER BY health.override_until, health.model_config_id LIMIT #{limit}
